label: copy phase: re-fed input t or g (from original position >= 2)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), and only from recall_idx 3 onward. It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter. Its input-token selectivity is sharp: the re-fed token t carries about 61% of activation mass (lift 17x) and g about 31% (lift 11x). Weak, low-magnitude firing also occurs on o and m (together about 5% of mass). It never fires on the first occurrence of a token in the sequence, which is trivially true because copy-phase inputs repeat earlier tokens. The firing rate rises with step index and is highest for L = 9. The strongest activations are t at recall_idx 3, often with i before it and z after it, but the out_tok and prev_tok effects are diffuse. Recall is good (dev recall 0.85, mass recall 0.92), but precision is only about 0.47: more than half of copy-phase t/g inputs at recall_idx >= 3 do not cross threshold. No simple condition tested (to_go, in_count, digit count, prev_tok, out_tok) separates the active cases from the inactive ones without losing most of the recall.
